title: Grabbiest Grabber

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Allows you to pick up even more objects at once for longer.

body:
"Harnessing the true ultimate power of refinedness... Using the coolness, and awesomeness of magic. Allows you to grab multiple objects with the power of wormholes, you can also buy a cheaper version at The Oak Depot!"


The Grabbiest Grabber is a tool which can be purchased for $75,000 at the Lighthouse. It allows the user to project a large zone that lets them pick up multiple loose objects.

Description

The Grabbiest Grabber is a power gauntlet with a two-pronged claw on its end, built using the same materials that the refined tools use. It emits a harsh blue glow from its internal components.

The Grabbiest Grabber functions identically to the cheaper Grabby Grabber. However, the Grabbiest Grabber projects a much larger sphere of influence to grab objects with, allowing it to do things like pick up entire ore nodes in one go. The field the Grabbiest Grabber projects also lasts for 60 seconds, compared to the 12 seconds of the Grabby Grabber.

Trivia

  • The Grabbiest Grabber (and its Grabby counterpart) have been involved with multiple in-game tricks/exploits that allow for flight. The developers frequently have to patch tricks players use to fly.
  • Before the map revamp event, there was a sneak peak image of the Grabbiest Grabber in one of the thumbnails where Bob Fridman is at the counter. The Boxed Grabbiest Grabber was at the shelf where, in the game at that time, the Statistic Tools and the Jars belonged.
  • During the map update, the description of the Grabbiest Grabber was changed to refer to the Lighthouse rather than Jer's Junkyard as the location where a player can buy the Grabby Grabber.
  • The Boxed image version of the Grabbiest Grabber doesn't look like the tool itself because it has a third grabber finger on the image, which bears more similarity to the Grabby Grabber's appearance.
  • In Version 1.5.0, the Grabbiest Grabber was given a light-up bar, bringing it more in line with the Grabby Grabber. This was previously absent.
  • The Grabbiest Grabber is likely to be inspired in the Proton-24 from Refinery Caves as it has got the same usage, idea, and it even references the game in its description as it mentions a word from the refine family.
